description: T-13: Child Mode Parent Gate & Flow Polish. Replace the 'Back' text link on /learn and /learn/reading with a hidden lock-icon parent gate (Lucide Lock, top-right, low contrast). Unlocked by long-press 1.5s or 3 taps in 1s, shows a parent menu with Switch child and Exit options. Adds a ChildSwitcher overlay for swapping profiles mid-session.
